Definition: Jobab, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners
BiblicalUsage: Jobab is named 9 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Genesis 10:29; Joshua 11:1; 1 Chronicles 1:23. In Genesis 10:29 we read, "And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Chronicles 1:23 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Jobab is brief in Scripture and long in God's memory, and that is my conviction. The Bible does not waste names, and neither does God.
RelatedPeople: Jobab, Son of Joktan; Jobab, King of Madon
